Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

Multiplying x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ the long way gives a degree-3 mess. Factor first and almost everything cancels before you multiply.硬乘 x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ 会得到一堆三次式。先分解，乘之前几乎全都约掉了。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  1. Multiply: factor everything, cancel any top with any bottom, then multiply what is left.乘法：全部分解，任一分子可与任一分母约分，再把剩下的相乘。
  2. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the SECOND fraction.除法：乘以第二个分式的倒数。
  3. Division NPVs: both denominators AND the numerator of the divisor.除法的不允许值：两个分母，再加上除式的分子。

🧗 The hard part难点 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

All the NPVs in a division除法里的全部不允许值

After flipping, the divisor numerator hides in the denominator and its restriction gets missed.翻转后除式的分子跑到分母里，它的限制最容易漏。

  1. x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​: denominators x=3, 0x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​：分母给出 x=3, 0
  2. Divisor numerator: x2−4=0 → x=±2除式分子：x2−4=0 → x=±2
  3. Flip & cancel: x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​翻转并约分：x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​
  4. NPVs: x=−2,0,2,3不允许值：x=−2,0,2,3
Try试一试
Simplify x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​ and state all NPVs.化简 x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​，并写出全部不允许值。
Answer答案
(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​, x=−4, ±3, 1(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​，x=−4, ±3, 1

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  • In ÷x+1x−5​, forgetting x=5 ✗ — it lands on the bottom after flipping.÷x+1x−5​ 漏写 x=5 ✗——翻转后它到了分母。
  • Cancelling across +: in xx+3​ nothing cancels.跨加号约分：xx+3​ 什么都不能约。
🎯
List the NPVs before you flip — three places, one line.翻转之前先列不允许值——三个来源，一行写完。

cards.f: Dividing rational expressions: first move?有理式相除第一步？
cards.b: Factor everything and list NPVs (including the divisor’s numerator), then flip.全部分解并列出不允许值（包括除式分子），再颠倒。

cards.f: Can a top cancel with a bottom of the OTHER fraction?一个分式的分子能和另一个分式的分母约吗？
cards.b: Yes, when multiplying.能，乘法时可以。

cards.f: 3x​÷6x​ = ?3x​÷6x​＝？
cards.b: 3x​⋅x6​=2, x=0.3x​⋅x6​=2，x=0。

cards.f: Why factor before multiplying?为什么要先分解再相乘？
cards.b: Cancelling early keeps degrees low and errors rare.先约分次数低，不容易错。

quiz.q: State all NPVs of x−5x​÷x−1x+2​, then simplify.写出 x−5x​÷x−1x+2​ 的全部不允许值，再化简。
quiz.hint: Three sources: two bottoms and the divisor’s top.三处来源：两个分母和除式的分子。

quiz.q: A ferry route is modelled with a design parameter x>4. The crossing distance is D=xx2−16​ km and the ferry speed is v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min. (a) Write the crossing time t=D÷v as one simplified expression and list every non-permissible value. (b) Explain why only x>4 makes sense for the story. (c) For x=8, find D, v and t, and convert v to km/h.一条渡轮航线用设计参数 x>4 建模。航程为 D=xx2−16​ km，渡轮速度为 v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min。(a) 把航行时间 t=D÷v 写成一个最简式，并列出所有不允许值。(b) 说明为什么只有 x>4 才符合情境。(c) 当 x=8 时求 D、v、t，并把 v 换算成 km/h。
quiz.hint: Dividing by v means multiplying by x2−x−12x2​. Factor first.除以 v 就是乘以 x2−x−12x2​。先分解因式。
quiz.ans: (a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ min, x=0,4,−3; (b) x−4>0 makes both D and v positive; (c) D=6 km, v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h, t=1196​≈8.7 min.(a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ 分钟，x=0,4,−3；(b) x−4>0 才使 D 和 v 同为正；(c) D=6 km，v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h，t=1196​≈8.7 分钟。
quiz.why: t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​.t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​。
